events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up where guests can browse Calzedonia legwear, refresh their look, create content and use on-site beauty and photo activations.
events.what_is_free: Public admission, coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups, skincare sampling and the photo booth are advertised as complimentary. Embroidery is complimentary with purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: The pop-up is described as open to the public. Complimentary embroidery requires purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs; samples and promotional items remain subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: September 12 and 13, 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is established in the current public listings.

events.address: Revelie Luncheonette, 179 Prince St, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A two-hour public launch pop-up for Maison Madison's new mug collection at Revelie Luncheonette.
events.what_is_free: Admission to browse the launch is free; mugs and other merchandise are retail products.
events.caveats: Current event listings explicitly describe the pop-up as open to the public. No complimentary product or food is established, so this is listed as a free-to-enter retail pop-up rather than a giveaway event.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 11 AM–1 PM at Revelie Luncheonette, 179 Prince Street. No RSVP requirement is published.

events.event_name: Beauty Break with Urban Outfitters and Yes Day
events.address: Urban Outfitters, 1333 Broadway, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A three-hour beauty pop-up with an aura photo booth, Dirty Soda Bar, bouquet bar and Yes Day customization.
events.what_is_free: The aura photo booth, Dirty Soda Bar, bouquet bar and other advertised activations are free while supplies last. Customization by Original Rose is complimentary with a Yes Day purchase.
events.caveats: The advertised activations are free while supplies last. Customization is only complimentary with a Yes Day purchase. The Eventbrite registration is the direct advertised RSVP path; no host-approval step is stated.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–3 PM at Urban Outfitters, 1333 Broadway. Use the Eventbrite listing for the current free RSVP path.

events.address: Yaya Tea, 206 Grand St, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: A public launch event for the Claire's × Yaya Tea boba-inspired accessories collection, with an interactive claw machine and product preview.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests are advertised to receive a complimentary Yaya × Claire's boba drink and one item from the collection. The event itself is open to the public while supplies last.
events.caveats: The first-50 drink and collection-item offer is quantity-limited. Current event listings say the event opens to the public at noon and runs while supplies last; no RSVP or approval requirement is stated.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–3 PM at Yaya Tea, 206 Grand Street. Kids are welcome according to the current listings.
